prompt: Two friends visit a park: Ana every $4$ days, Ben every $6$ days. In how many days will they both visit on the same day next?
hint: You need the LCM of $4$ and $6$.

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Rewrite the numbers in matching form (all fractions OR all decimals) before you operate.
You need the LCM of $4$ and $6$.
Smallest number that's a multiple of both $4$ and $6$.
